programme.title: Weather For the Week Ahead
programme.desc: Detailed weather report. Bringing you details of current weather conditions for across the UK and what to expect for the next seven days. With forecasts, temperatures and weather warnings. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. The BBC is aims to be a totally impartial public service broadcaster, and was established by Royal Charter. The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by British households, and is regulated by Ofcom. They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: BBC One's flagship morning current affairs programme with news headlines and regular weather reports. Start your day with the biggest national and international stories. Breakfast takes a look at the day's papers and brings you the latest developments in sports, politics, business and entertainment. Breakfast welcomes guests to the studio for a chat. Whilst analysis and special reports offer a greater understanding of important subjects. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Morning Live
programme.desc: Morning show discussing key topics of conversation of the previous week. The best start of Sunday: lively chat about social and religious issues, and highlights of extraordinary stories of ordinary people. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Learn the tricks of the trade when you go to the auctions with Homes Under the Hammer. Join presenters Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell as they follow the renovation stories of properties across Britain as they get transformed from empty shells and outdated buildings to desirable spaces and contemporary homes. Watch as ordinary people breathe new life into the otherwise unloved houses, and find out how well they managed to stay within budget. Will they sell and make a profit, or have they invested too much money in a project that wont sell? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Two teams of amateur collectors meet at an antiques fair to compete to turn in the largest profit from a £300 budget. The teams receive guidance from expert traders, who give feedback on which items are most likely to attract the highest bids. The contestants first head to the High Street to acquire items they want to trade. Any leftover money is taken by their mentors, who go shopping for extra items as 'bonus buys'. The teams must decide which 'package' of goodies should be taken to auction, on the understanding that they may turn in a profit or loss on their investment decisions. The show has been on air since March 2000, being voted Most Popular Daytime Programme in 2002 and Best Lifestyle Show in 2003. It was also nominated for Most Popular Factual Entertainment Programme in 2003. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: Early afternoon round-up of the day's biggest national and international stories. The BBC News Team bring you the headlines and essential up-to-the-minute information about the latest developments. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Push factors from the noisy, bustling cities of Britain, combined with the alluring peace of the countryside, has the population dreaming of homes in more scenic surroundings. Escape to the Country sees buyers from different areas on the UK considering their options to settle down in the English countryside. Presenters show off a range of prospective homes, before they must make their final decision towards the end of the show. Each episode taking place in a different region of the UK, we see a wide variety of beautiful homes across the country. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Carl from Hull is our first visitor to Edinburgh's historic Leith Theatre, selling some antique handcuffs from his personal collection. Who says crime doesn't pay? Back to try her luck in front of the dealers once again is young Charlotte from Cambridge. She may have found her designer Paul Secon lampshade in a charity shop, but that doesn't mean she'll be giving it away... Shop display items are usually in demand, and it looks like Tracey has doubled her chances of a profit by bringing in two mannequin heads. Simon Bower and Nigel Havers are charmed, but how will Tracey get on when she faces the dealers? Joining us next from the west coast of Scotland is Robert, with an impressive concrete bust. It's an imposing decorative piece, but questions over its antique appeal might mean bids are hard to come by. It may be more of a collectable curio than a working model these days, but if Brian focuses on the right buyer, his vintage camera is sure to be a moneymaker. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, friends Paula, Ranie, Aaron and Pam – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: The high pressure game show, where pointless answers are the way to win. Contestants not only have to answer questions correctly, but give the answer that scores the least points. They do this by coming up with the least obvious answers, that other people struggle to come up with in a survey of individuals. A correct answer that nobody else managed to say is a pointless answer, the best possible outcome. A pointless answer in the final round is how you win the jackpot, cash prize, which grows with every episode until someone wins. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The One Show
programme.desc: A show with big-name guests and special reports on a range of subjects including consumer rights, current affairs and contemporary issues. The One Show looks at topics from the quirky and rare to much more serious matters. Since first hitting British screens in 2006, The One Show has welcomed hundreds of celebrities to its sofa. With high-profile from stage, screen, sport, music, politics and more; including then-British-Prime Minister Theresa May, Daniel Radcliffe, Dame Judy Dench, Sir Tom Jones and many, many more. With fun, laughs and the occasional musical number. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Have I Got News for You
programme.desc: Re-runs featuring favourite moments from the irreverent current affairs quiz show that shines a spotlight on the key news stories and scandals of the particular week in question. Satirical magazine editor Ian Hislop and deadpan comedian Paul Merton are the regular team captains who send up politicians, celebrities, royalty and sports stars and each other with due aplomb. The panel game was hosted by Angus Deayton throughout the 1990s, until he found himself embroiled in the kind of tabloid scandal that the show was designed to highlight and lampoon. The vacant chair has since been taken by a host of VIP ringmasters, from Boris Johnson to Ruby Wax, Jeremy Clarkson to Jo Brand, leading the panelists through regular topics covering TV and newspaper stories, obscure links between famous people, and the cheeky missing words from headlines round in which the teams nudge the boundaries of taste and legality. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Graham Norton Show
programme.desc: Graham Norton plays host to his celebrity guests, who are invited to chat, play games and give an insider view on stories that grab the public's attention, especially within the world of entertainment. International stars of the calibre of Tom Cruise, Tom Hanks and Will Smith have joined in the fun, but whether the guests are top league or minor list celebs, the interview couch is never short of a little star voltage, or a cheeky story or two to keep viewers enthralled. The critics have awarded Graham with the gold standard of talk shows, and there's nothing that he is not prepared to discuss with his VIP interviewees. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK
programme.desc: Follow RuPaul's search for the United Kingdom's next drag superstar in this exciting and fun reality show. The candidates compete showcasing their charisma and entertaining talents in front of a panel of celebrity judges. Each week there are new tasks for the Queens, consisting of the mini and main challenge, a runway walk and a a lip sync battle, after which one of the competing ladies gets eliminated. RuPaul has three roles on the show, serving as the host, a coach and a judge. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: BBC One's flagship morning current affairs programme with news headlines and regular weather reports. Start your day with the biggest national and international stories. Breakfast takes a look at the day's papers and brings you the latest developments in sports, politics, business and entertainment. Breakfast welcomes guests to the studio for a chat. Whilst analysis and special reports offer a greater understanding of important subjects. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen
programme.desc: Cookery programme full of mouth-watering food, great chefs and celebrity guests. Show typically includes a host chef and two guest chefs, each cooking in the studio. They are joined by a celebrity guest, usually on to promote current project. Some of the show's famous segments are archive footage from various other TV chef shows, Omelette Challenge, where the two invited chefs must cook an omelette as fast as possible and Heaven and Hell test which requires the celebrity guest to name their most and least favourite foods and viewers then vote which one of them will be prepared for them. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Simply Nigella
programme.desc: Packed with new recipes and tips designed to make our busy lives easier, Simply Nigella proves that whatever the occasion, food, in the eating and the making, should always be pleasurable. This episode is all about dishes that marry the comfort of the familiar with the freshness of the new, like Nigella's grown-up take on a family favourite – fluffy oat pancakes with a raspberry and honey syrup. For a fun lunch, there is a riff on the classic Caesar salad. A casual supper with friends sees Nigella serving a green-inspired feast of squid and orzo pasta, complete with the Greek dessert of old rag pie – a sweet and savoury twist on a cheesecake. And finally, Nigella's take on a rice bowl with ginger, radish and avocado celebrates a few choice ingredients, resulting in a dish that is calming and uplifting to look at, as well as to eat. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bargain Hunt: Celebrating Soaps
programme.desc: Danny Sebastian finds himself in a bubble bath at the start of this special episode – but it's not that kind of soap he's talking about! He's celebrating TV soap operas in a drama-filled showdown between two teams of actors. In red are Donna Edwards and Dyfan Rees, and in blue are Sera Cracroft and Sophie Mensah, all co-stars from Welsh language drama series Pobol y Cwm, which marks its 50th birthday this year. Pobol y Cwm is set in a fictional rural community in west Wales, with plenty of plot twists and turns. Danny takes a peek behind the scenes on their film set and also meets TV soap superfan Steve Marshall, who has spent the last 40 years building an impressive collection of memorabilia from EastEnders, Emmerdale, Coronation Street and other long-running dramas. It's lights, camera, action as the actors shop for antiques at a huge fair in Builth Wells, mid Wales. Guiding Donna and Dyfan is Kate Bliss. Their first spot is an old London street sign, but does it point the way to a profit? Over with the blues, a rustic kitchen table catches Sophie's eye, but the price tag says 'sold'. And there's an impromptu Welsh lesson for expert Izzie Balmer. There's plenty of drama at the auction in Royal Wootton Bassett, but which team will exit stage left with the most profit? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: Money For Nothing is a British TV program hosted by Sarah Moore, Jay Blades and EJ Osborne. The hosts save things from being dumped and transform them into valuable pieces, making money for people who had no idea there was cash to be made from their old useless stuff. Any profit is then returned to those people. The team salvage items from recycling centers and transform them into unique treasures. They manage to recycle old bowling balls, cooperate with designers to give a second life to old furniture, create a gorgeous dress from a salvaged leather sofa and work all kinds of miracles. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Learn the tricks of the trade when you go to the auctions with Homes Under the Hammer. Join presenters Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell as they follow the renovation stories of properties across Britain as they get transformed from empty shells and outdated buildings to desirable spaces and contemporary homes. Watch as ordinary people breathe new life into the otherwise unloved houses, and find out how well they managed to stay within budget. Will they sell and make a profit, or have they invested too much money in a project that wont sell? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Push factors from the noisy, bustling cities of Britain, combined with the alluring peace of the countryside, has the population dreaming of homes in more scenic surroundings. Escape to the Country sees buyers from different areas on the UK considering their options to settle down in the English countryside. Presenters show off a range of prospective homes, before they must make their final decision towards the end of the show. Each episode taking place in a different region of the UK, we see a wide variety of beautiful homes across the country. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Countryfile Ramble for BBC Children in Need
programme.desc: Discover more about the British countryside as the presenters visit rural homes and areas to bring stories about nature and wildlife and environmental topics to a wider audience. The programme focuses on seasonal subjects with an overarching theme of conservation, species protection, the preservation of the rural way of life and challenges facing modern farming communities. The Sunday morning show has been presented by John Craven since its launch, and features competitions, interviews, studio debates and market reports. Special productions include bird species census counts, with members of the public taking part in surveys, and tips for farmers, conservationists, ramblers and nature lovers alike. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Final Score
programme.desc: Final Score is a weekly BBC sports show, covering the latest news and results from Britain's football leagues, with special editions during holidays and on the final day of the Premier League season. A group of experts discuss the played matches watching highlights, and review the league tables. Exclusive interviews with players and managers are also included. Find out all you need to know about the country's favorite sport. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing
programme.desc: Long-running British talent competition, in which celebrities are paired up with professional dancers, in the hope of winning the popular audience vote and being crowned the winning duo of each series. All of the celebrities, who are drawn from the worlds of sport, entertainment, politics, arts and media, are novices on the dancefloors, and have only a few days to plan and perfect their performances with the help of their professional partners. The musical element is provided by a live studio orchestra, and each of the teams are appraised and scored by a panel of expert judges. But the decision as to which pair drops out each weekend is down to the votes of viewers at home. There are multiple elimination rounds and only the best pairs will make the grand final. programme.title: Film: Rush
programme.desc:
Niki Lauda (Daniel Brühl) plant seine Rennsport-Karriere und sein Leben strategisch, kühl wägt er stets Risiko und Ergebnis ab. Ganz anders sein Titelrivale James Hunt (Chris Hemsworth). Dem gut aussehenden Lebemann, der aus der englischen Oberschicht stammt, fliegt alles nur so zu – und er genießt das Leben mit allen Sinnen. Schampus für alle. 

Dem Asketen Lauda ist das zwar nicht geheuer, aber andererseits bewundert er die Lässigkeit seines Konkurrenten auch. Auf dem Kurs allerdings kennt Ferrari-Pilot Lauda kein Pardon. Die Saison 1976 beginnt der Österreicher als Weltmeister, und auch in dem Jahr scheint die Konkurrenz chancenlos. Doch dann baut Lauda einen schrecklichen Unfall...

Das Ende ist zwar kein Geheimnis, denn das Leben schrieb die Handlung von „Rush“, aber das sind häufig sowieso die besten Geschichten. Und wenn dann noch so ein Film herauskommt – umso besser. Neben „Grand Prix“ (1966) von John Frankenheimer und „Le Mans“ (1971) mit Steve McQueen gehört „Rush“ zu den besten Rennfahrerfilmen. 

Ron Howard („Apollo 13“) bietet spektakuläre Rennszenen, doch der Film ist in erster Linie das fesselnde Porträt zweier Männer, die unterschiedlicher nicht sein könnten, deren Beziehung aber immer von größtem Respekt geprägt war.

programme.title: Points of View
programme.desc: Long-running British series that allows members of the public to voice their opinions on BBC television shows from recent weeks. Broadcast in a short, 10-minute-long format, each episode reads out letters/emails from viewers who wish to praise, criticise or comment on a programme that has appeared on any of the BBC's numerous channels. The series first aired back in 1961, and has continued to act as a reference point for people to have their say on the shows they've seen, whether good or bad. It has employed the services of several notable presenters over past decades, with Tina Daheley acting as narrator since 2018. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Songs of Praise
programme.desc: An exploration of religious music in Britain. The presenters look into different genres and visit churches and cathedrals around the country, where the congregations sing various classical and modern hymns and worship songs. Join to gain a better understanding of the importance of singing in Christianity. The series also includes segments like news and interviews that are of interest to the Christian viewers. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: War Horse
programme.desc: Farmerssohn Albert (Jeremy Irvine) ist traurig, als sein Pferd an die britische Kavallerie verkauft wird. Während des Ersten Weltkriegs gerät der temperamentvolle Vollbluthengst Joey in deutsche Gefangenschaft. Später findet er Unterschlupf bei einem französischen Bauern, bevor er auf den Schlachtfeldern an der Somme schwer verwundet wird…\n\nZwischen Kunst und Kitsch pendelnd, schuf Spielberg aus Michael Morpurgos Romanvorlage eine akribisch ausgestattete Hommage an die Hollywood-Epen der 40er- und 50er-Jahre. Sechs Oscar-Nominierungen für ein visuelles Meisterstück!

programme.title: Planet Earth: A Tale of Three Bears
programme.desc: Sam, Sophie and Sybil are three tiny black bear cubs who have just emerged from their den in the Northwoods of Minnesota. But this spectacular wilderness is full of threats – wolves and coyotes roam the forest looking for stray cubs, the weather can be dangerously unpredictable bringing blizzards and forest fires, and every year some of the black bears are killed by humans. Their survival depends entirely on the experience of their mother and how well they learn the skills she teaches them. With the help of bear expert Dr Lynn Rogers, Julia Bradbury explores the woods, learning about the lives of the black bears and the particular trials facing these three vulnerable little cubs. Sam, Sophie and Sybil must follow their mother's lead closely if they are going to survive in this tough and unforgiving wilderness and make it through this critical month. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Bioacoustics technology and AI have allowed scientists to not only decode complex animal sound data but also begin communicating with animals. While this may mean the salvation of countless animal species, the advent of inter-species communication could also have far-reaching risks for the ecosystem. In her quest to learn about the current state of animal communication, Professor Hannah Fry travels across the world, meeting Cash the talking dog in California and deciphering elephant rumbles in Nairobi. She looks into the question of whether the emerging ability to communicate with animals is one that should be exploited. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Maisie Adam, Ade Edmondson, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sammi Kinghorn take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing.
programme.desc: Paul and Bob are back in Norfolk – a bittersweet return, as this was the very first location where Ted joined them. They both reminisce about Ted and raise a cup in his memory – although Ted would have preferred a biscuit. They head to some prime Norfolk lakes, hoping to catch a bream. It's been well documented that Bob is not a fan of the bream, but will a big catch make him change his tune? It's Paul and Bob's birthday week, and they consider whether they may celebrate any further milestones or simply let them pass. Bob ends up throwing a surprise 70s-themed birthday party for Paul on the roof of the Blickling Estate, once owned by the Boleyn family. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Experts claim that artificial intelligence has begun to exhibit early signs of agency. What does the rise of the superintelligence mean for society? Is humanity on a path to superintelligence or hurtling towards self-destruction? Professor Hannah Fry explores the promises and threats of AI, considering the ways in which superintelligent machines could help humanity as well as the ways in which they could be a hindrance. Over the course of the episode, a range of experts discuss the future of humanity in the age of AI. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 30 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Comedian Jason Manford hosts an exciting, fast-paced quiz show, where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle The Answer Run down towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face The Final Run and win the chance to take home their cash prize. Who will swipe their way to victory? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher explores the food market in Hay-on-Wye, getting tips on growing food and finding out the secret to making fudge. Chef Julie Lin discovers bargains in world food stores and supermarket aisles, and food journalist Leyla Kazim lifts the lid on smoothies. Ryan Hand finds out how to get wood-fired pizza perfection in an oven. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's Scottish railway journey reaches Aberdeen. From the Granite City, Michael heads straight out to a dramatic piece of coastline 18 miles to its north. Forvie National Nature Reserve is 1000 hectares of protected coastal habitat dominated by grassy dunes. It's a wild and fantastic landscape, and a perfect place to explore over and over again, since the dunes shift and change all the time. Returning to Aberdeen, Michael finds out about the languages, dialects and vernacular of Scotland from a young ballad singer, who talks to him in Gaelic, Scots and Doric, and sings him a Scots ballad. Dyce is Michael's next stop. It's the station for Aberdeen airport and the location for many businesses related to Scotland's global energy industry. It's an industry Michael knew well as a young special adviser to the energy secretary, and memories of flying out to oil and gas platforms remain with him. If there is an accident, training can make the difference between life and death. Michael is thrown in at the deep end, training for the terrifying scenario of a helicopter making a controlled descent into the sea. The most easterly town in Scotland is Michael's last port of call. At Peterhead, they land more fish than any other port in the United Kingdom. Michael is up early to see the traditional shout auction, where the catch is bought and sold, and to find out how the industry is coping after Brexit. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Dolphins of Shark Bay
programme.desc: A dolphin is about to be born in the treacherous waters of Shark Bay in Western Australia. Puck, the wise mother, must use all her skills to keep her newborn safe from the sharks that sweep into the bay every year. With the help of her close-knit family of females, she must teach the vulnerable baby dolphin the secrets of survival. From whistling to her unborn calf to the first few hours of baby Samu's life and the struggles her eldest son faces leaving home, this film provides a rare insight into the lives of bottlenose dolphins. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Flog It! comes from Blackburn Cathedral in the heart of the town centre. The experts on duty today are Anita Manning and Philip Serrell. Anita values a gold charm bracelet, and Philip takes a shine to an unusual globe. Paul Martin learns about the remarkable life and work of classical singer Kathleen Ferrier. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: New: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Maisie Adam, Ade Edmondson, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sammi Kinghorn take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's the end of an era on Gardeners' World as Monty approaches his final programme from Longmeadow, the garden he has shared with the nation for the last 16 years. With Ned by his side, he celebrates the enduring pleasures of gardening and serves up one last bulb lasagne. Autumn is a busy time with vegetables to sow, perennials to plant and windfall apples to collect. Carol Klein takes a deep dive into the scientific world of plants. This time, it's all about the magical properties of their shoots. Joe Swift visits close friend and garden designer Ann-Marie Powell to explore her own garden, a place that has become her solace since the death of her husband last year. In North Yorkshire, there's a remarkable, pioneering woman on a quest to grow thousands of trees from seed. And a couple in East Grinstead share their combined love for the garden they have created together. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Who Do You Think You Are?
programme.desc: Nine celebrities trace their family trees to explore the lives of their ancestors and uncover major themes in British social history. Famous gardener Monty Don comes from a well-known dynasty of architects on his mother's side of the family but knows little about his other relatives. He starts his investigation with a visit to his older brother David. Amongst the family memorabilia, they find a photograph of their great-grandmother Charlotte Wyatt, whose maiden name was Hodge. Monty is intrigued as no-one in the family has spoken much of the Hodges. Monty's efforts lead him to a port near Anglesey, where he learns of extraordinary colonial travels and a national disaster that ended in a family tragedy. On his father's side, Monty has heard that his ancestors were part of the famous Keiller marmalade dynasty, based in Dundee. Following their invention of chip marmalade, the Keillers became immensely rich, but Monty's immediate family saw none of the fortune. So where did the missing marmalade millions go? Monty travels to Scotland to discover how his great-grandfather was involved in the business. He unearths a bitter family feud that finally answers his questions about the Keiller fortune. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Planes, Trains And Automobiles
programme.desc: Werbemanager Neal Page (Steve Martin) freut sich auf Thanksgiving im Familienkreis. Leider entwickelt sich der Heimflug nach Chicago zur Tortur: Ohne Unterlass plappert Duschvorhangvertreter Del (John Candy) auf ihn ein. Ein Schneesturm zwingt die Piloten, nach Kansas auszuweichen. Neal muss in einem schäbigen Hotelzimmer übernachten – mit Del! Und das Schlimmste soll erst noch kommen…\n\nJohn Hughes, sonst Spezi für gehobene Teeniefilme („Breakfast Club“), gelang ein witziger, anrührender Balanceakt zwischen Slapstick und Satire. Die Chaos-Odyssee zweier unterschiedlicher Charaktere ist zudem bestens besetzt.

programme.title: Film: Their Finest
programme.desc: 1940 fliegt die deutsche Luftwaffe verheerende Angriffe auf London. Um die Moral nicht in den (Luftschutz-)Keller sinken zu lassen, bringt die Politik Propagandafilme ins Kino, die jedoch ihre Wirkung beim Publikum verfehlen. Um dies zu ändern, wird Texterin Catrin Cole (Arterton) verpflichtet, die Englands Tapferkeit um die „weibliche Perspektive“ bereichern soll. Es dauert, bis sie sich Respekt verschafft. \n\nDie dänische Regisseurin Lone Scherfig („An Education“) mixt sehr gekonnt Emanzipationsdrama mit ironischen Reflexionen über die Manipulationskraft des Mediums – das ist so lehrreich wie herzerwärmend.

programme.title: Inside Iran: The People's Story – Panorama.
programme.desc: The story of Iranians who have lived through the most turbulent and traumatic of years, with widespread street protests, a brutal crackdown by the authorities and a war launched against Iran by the US and Israel. The film follows one mother who begins the year planning a future with her daughter only to see it end with a promise to avenge her daughter's death. After she publicly blamed the Iranian authorities, she was forced to flee the country and live in exile. A medic reveals how his life has changed after treating hundreds of protesters, many with gunshot wounds, while a man who also fled Iran in fear shares the last messages from a relative, sentenced to death. Filmed both inside and outside the country, this is the raw and uncompromising story of a year in Iran, told by some of the people who were there. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sisters in Country: Dolly Linda and Emmylou.
programme.desc: Documentary which explores how Dolly Parton, Linda Ronstadt and Emmylou Harris's careers took off in the 1970s with very distinct takes on country before they ended up uniting as close harmony singers and eventually collaborated on 1987's four-million-selling debut album, Trio. In the 60s, country music was viewed by most of America as blue collar, and Dolly was country through and through. Linda Ronstadt's take on classic country helped make her the biggest female star in mid-70s America. Folkie Emmylou learned about country from mentor Gram Parsons and, after his death in 1973, she became a bandleader in her own right. It was Emmylou and Linda – the two west coast folk rockers – who voiced their mutual appreciation of Dolly, the mountain girl singer from Tennessee, when they became early students of her work. The artists talk about uniting as harmony singers and eventually collaborating on their debut album, Trio. The album helped launch the mountain music revival that would peak with the soundtrack to O Brother, Where Art Thou? In 2012, Linda Ronstadt was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease, which left her unable to sing, but 2016 saw unreleased songs from their sessions compiled to create a third Trio album. This is the story of how their alliance made them pioneers in bringing different music worlds together and raising the game for women in the country tradition. Contributors: Dolly Parton, Emmylou Harris, Linda Ronstadt, Rodney Crowell, George Lucas, Peter Asher, Chris Hillman, Laura Cantrell, Robert K Oermann, John Boylan, Phil Kaufman, David Lindley, Albert Lee, Herb Pedersen, George Massenberg and Applewood Road. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Aberfan: The Village That Fought Back.
programme.desc: The collapse of a coal waste tip above the Welsh village of Aberfan in 1966 is one of the most devastating disasters in modern British history, killing 144 people. In the aftermath, a grieving community takes on the government, demanding justice and the removal of the huge tips still threatening the village. Their campaign confronts those in power and fights to prevent another disaster. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: Blossom is terrible at keeping secrets, and Trevor can't help but point that out. To prove him wrong, Blossom refuses to reveal the secret hiding place for her piece of the Amulet of Protection, even though the heroes need it to stop Balthazar casting a weather spell on the forest. With a rain of crabs heading their way, the heroes must quickly persuade Blossom to reveal her secret. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Grand Hotel
programme.desc: A group of very different individuals staying at a luxurious hotel in Berlin deal with each of their respective dramas. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Ice Station Zebra
programme.desc: Nach einer Explosion auf einer britischen Wetterstation am Nordpol wird das US-Atom-U-Boot „Tigerfish“ um Hilfe gebeten. Während der Fahrt ins Packeis erfährt Kommandant Ferraday (Rock Hudson) den eigentlichen Grund seiner Mission: Ein sowjetischer Spionagesatellit ist in der Nähe der Wetterstation niedergegangen und soll geborgen werden. Freilich interessieren sich auch die Sowjets für den brisanten Inhalt: Fotos von geheimen Raketenbasen der USA und der UdSSR… \n\nDas Atom-U-Boot in diesem klassischen Abenteuer zählt zu den größten Schiffsmodellen, die je für einen Hollywood-Film gebaut wurden.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Today, Flog It! comes from the Blickling Estate in north Norfolk. Five antiques experts are on hand to find a selection of objects to take to auction. David Harper is excited by an early device for watching films, whilst David Fletcher and James Lewis reminisce about Rupert the Bear books and Dinky toys. Paul Martin enjoys a ride in a tank on a historic former military camp. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MOTD Live: FA Cup 1st Round
programme.desc: The FA Cup is the oldest knock-out tournament in England. Provided the Football Association, the competition provides raw emotion through "giant-killings" and 'underdog stories'. Premier League clubs enter in the third round of the tournament and with non-league teams starting the proceedings , n the early qualifying rounds, it promises to be another successful spectacle for viewers. In navigating to the latter stages of the knock-out rounds, teams all receive an amount of prize money that can be re-invested into training facilities and improvements to their respected grounds. With the final at Wembley, our exclusive coverage of this historic tournament will provide in-depth analysis and information. In keeping with the traditions of the trophy, Arsenal FC are the most successful (13). (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: Of the calls the RNLI respond to every year, some are a race against the tide while others are against the weather. But all of them are a race against time. The crew at Tower, on the River Thames in London, are the busiest of all the lifeboat stations, averaging over 500 shouts a year and aiming to launch to any emergency in under 90 seconds. When a call comes in about a man in the water near the Thames Barrier, they reach him with just moments to spare. In Fleetwood, on the Lancashire coast, a desperate 999 call alerts the crew to a bait digger – out looking for worms on the sand flats – who has been caught out by the incoming spring tide and is in danger of being submerged and swept out to sea. And on the most southerly point of the Sussex coast, in Selsey, the crew race to the rescue of a local diver with a suspected case of 'the bends'. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: 40 TV Theme Tunes at the BBC
Film: The Taste of Things
programme.desc: Der vietnamesische Regisseur Trân Anh Hùng erzählt seine Geschichten in erlesenen Bildern. Filme wie „Der Duft der grünen Papaya“ (1993) oder „Naokos Lächeln“ (2010) sind moderne Klassiker des Arthouse-Kinos. Mit „Geliebte Köchin“ hat er nun einen Film gedreht, der in geschmackvoll arrangierten Stillleben die Kunst des Kochens feiert. In den ersten Minuten kann man dem Gourmet Dodin Bouffant (Benoît Magimel) und seiner Köchin Eugénie (Juliette Binoche) bei der Zubereitung eines vollkommenen Menüs zusehen. Dodin hatte Eugénie schon mehrere Heiratsanträge gemacht, doch bislang hat sie immer abgelehnt. Als sie nach einem Schwächeanfall das Bett hüten muss, beschließt er, für sie zu kochen – denn die Liebe geht bekanntlich durch den Magen.\n„Geliebte Köchin“ ist kulinarisches Kino in Vollendung. Ein Festmahl, das der Erbprinz von Eurasien für Bouffant zubereiten lässt, dauert ganze acht Stunden. Auch Trân Anh Hùng nimmt sich viel Zeit. Die visuellen Gaumenfreuden können allerdings nicht darüber hinwegtäuschen, dass die aus wenigen Zutaten bestehende Handlung nicht gerade üppig ausgefallen ist.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: Four familiar faces paired with a friend or a loved one leave their luxury lifestyles at the starting line for a journey that will take them to the other side of the world and push them to the limits of their endurance. The pairs embark on a life-changing adventure – a 7,500km race from the prehistoric jungles of Borneo to the sun-baked southern tip of Australia. Competing in this series are acclaimed singer-songwriter and musician Sam Ryder, and his best friend and tour manager, Kaz; veteran sports broadcaster Jeff Stelling and his son Matt; BRIT award-winning singer-songwriter Ella Eyre and childhood friend Nana; and influencer Princess Andre with her brother musician Junior Andre. Stripped of their smartphones and bank cards, these household names will be tested; emotions will run high, and relationships will be transformed on an adventure that's as challenging as it is rewarding. They will need to rely on their own resourcefulness and the kindness of strangers to reach the finish line, equipped with only a map and a budget of £26 each a day. Their race begins in Kuching, a vibrant city in north west Malaysian Borneo and the gateway to the island's vast wilderness. From there, the teams must cross three countries and two continents, weaving through five checkpoints before reaching the finish line in Melbourne, Australia. The teams must tackle the most formidable race yet – traversing the ancient jungles and indigenous heartlands of Borneo, navigating the Makassar Strait to Sulawesi, an island of cinematic, towering limestone cliffs, before reaching the kaleidoscopic splendour of Queensland's landscapes, from the turquoise blues of the Great Barrier Reef to the arid, expansive orange of the outback. Finally, they will thread through sprawling Sydney before reaching the finish line on the southern tip of Australia. Musician Sam and tour manager Kaz embrace an unexpected start to the race and dive straight in, relishing the chance to revisit the early days of their friendship when roughing it on tour was the norm. They undertake a jungle adventure, heading inland to connect with the indigenous Tae people. First-time backpackers Princess and Junior have shared a childhood in the public eye, making their sibling bond incredibly strong, but find themselves in at the deep end when trying to navigate the winding streets of the Sarawak capital. Keen to make the most of the adventure, they choose to spend time in Malaysia, putting in a shift at a family-run coconut farm in Mount Kuwai. Ella and best friend Nana bonded at school but now live countries apart. Hoping the race will reunite them, they embrace village life in West Kalimantan and are welcomed into a traditional Dayak longhouse. But with erratic public transport running through the remote rainforest, the pair face a nerve-racking dilemma. Determined to keep up with the youngest of the teams but the most cautious of the pairs, Jeff and his son Matt face an early test to their relationship as they get off to a faltering start. They manage to escape the intense equatorial heat by opting for water travel down the coast through the meandering river delta. As the series unfolds, the teams have to make it through some of the toughest legs the race has ever seen. Famous faces are tested like never before, relationships strengthen, and countless memories are made in jaw-dropping locations. The race starts now... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
programme.desc: Captivating documentary series that follows presenter and horticulturalist Christine Walkden as she explores and takes a look at some of Britain's most incredible gardens and countryside from a hot-air balloon. She will visit 15 counties, from Cornwall to Aberdeenshire, where she will look at some amazing gardens and landscapes, examine the rich history of places she visits, hear various fascinating stories and meet some colourful people who are dedicated to keeping these gardens grand and beautiful. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Discover more about the British countryside as the presenters visit rural homes and areas to bring stories about nature and wildlife and environmental topics to a wider audience. The programme focuses on seasonal subjects with an overarching theme of conservation, species protection, the preservation of the rural way of life and challenges facing modern farming communities. The Sunday morning show has been presented by John Craven since its launch, and features competitions, interviews, studio debates and market reports. Special productions include bird species census counts, with members of the public taking part in surveys, and tips for farmers, conservationists, ramblers and nature lovers alike. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. The BBC is aims to be a totally impartial public service broadcaster, and was established by Royal Charter. The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by British households, and is regulated by Ofcom. They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Long-running Scottish programme that focuses on various agricultural and rural issues, and tells the stories about the wildlife and nature of Scotland. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.sub-title: The Best Of, Spectacular Southern Structures
programme.desc: Popular Welsh weatherman Derek Brockway sets out on an amazing journey, exploring the wonderful landscapes and less familiar destinations of the nation's coastline. His route takes in a host of friendly and vibrant communities which are rich in culture and heritage. Brockway's inspiring walks reveal beautiful landmarks, from castles to lighthouses, as well as captivating local traditions that date back to ancient times. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Family film?
programme.desc: Four children dream of escaping the tedium of a summer holiday with their mother. When finally given permission to camp on their own on an island in the middle of a vast lake in the Lake District, they are overjoyed. But when they get there they discover they may not be alone. The battle for ownership of a lonely island teaches them the skills of survival, the value of friendship and the importance of holding your nerve. Based on the novel by Arthur Ransome. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: For a live demonstration of terroir, Eva heads to Domaine Dujac, home of the current most-wanted Burgundy wine. Standing on one side of a road, owner Jeremy Seysses points to a parcel of grand cru (the very best) of Clos de la Roche. On the other side is a premier cru (the next best) – a Gevrey-Chambertin Combottes. Back at the winery, Eva tucks into beef cheeks bathed in Domaine Dujac for a classic boeuf bourguignon lunch. Despite the grapes being grown just a few metres away, these reds are a class apart. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Two teams of amateur collectors meet at an antiques fair to compete to turn in the largest profit from a £300 budget. The teams receive guidance from expert traders, who give feedback on which items are most likely to attract the highest bids. The contestants first head to the High Street to acquire items they want to trade. Any leftover money is taken by their mentors, who go shopping for extra items as 'bonus buys'. The teams must decide which 'package' of goodies should be taken to auction, on the understanding that they may turn in a profit or loss on their investment decisions. The show has been on air since March 2000, being voted Most Popular Daytime Programme in 2002 and Best Lifestyle Show in 2003. It was also nominated for Most Popular Factual Entertainment Programme in 2003. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Learn the tricks of the trade when you go to the auctions with Homes Under the Hammer. Join presenters Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell as they follow the renovation stories of properties across Britain as they get transformed from empty shells and outdated buildings to desirable spaces and contemporary homes. Watch as ordinary people breathe new life into the otherwise unloved houses, and find out how well they managed to stay within budget. Will they sell and make a profit, or have they invested too much money in a project that wont sell? (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Joe ontdekt dat Frisbo verliefd is op Kayla Madani. Joe wil zijn beste vriend helpen maar er is één groot probleem. Kayla is de beste vriendin van Lily Scott. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Dagelijkse liveshow waarin de KETNET-wrappers je meetrekken in de wereld van KETNET en die van de Ketnetters. Verwacht je aan bekende gasten, zotte primeurs, leuke optredens, spannende spelletjes en nog zo veel meer. HALLO KROKET! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ket & Doc
programme.desc: Charlotte en Husna zijn beste vriendinnen, ze wonen allebei in de Antwerpse wijk Luchtbal en spelen samen bij de voetbalclub City Pirates. Elke week gaan ze samen naar de training en in het weekend spelen ze hun wedstrijd. Ze dromen allebei van een professionele voetbalcarrière; wie weet schoppen ze het zelfs tot bij de nationale ploeg. Maar Charlottes talent valt op – na de zomer zal ze een transfer maken naar een beter team en dan moet ze op internaat. Binnenkort zal Husna dus haar beste vriendin moeten missen; enkel vanop de zijlijn zullen ze nog voor elkaar supporteren. Blijven de meisjes #friendshipgoals? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Skate
programme.desc: Compilatieaflevering van de Vlaamse fictiereeks die zich afspeelt in de skatescene. Otis droomt van een reis naar Australië en wordt skateleerkracht maar een rivaliteit met het nieuwste lid van Frontside, Tess, zet alles op scherp. Terwijl Otis zichzelf probeert te bewijzen, maakt hij fouten die zijn dromen en vriendschappen op de proef stellen. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Noorse fictiereeks over de avonturen van een groep vrienden op kampeervakantie. Nederlandstalige versie (orig.: 'Campingplassen') (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Sarah schakelt de Prank Squad in om Ketnet-wrapper Héritier terug te pakken. Ze bedenken samen een plan om hem onder te dompelen in scheerschuim. Kawtar heeft een taart gemaakt voor hem maar niets is wat het lijkt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Rudyard en Tess willen allebei de hoofdrol in de musical spelen. Rudyard krijgt de rol, maar verzwijgt dat hij niet kan zingen. Hij wou de rol enkel omdat de tegenspeelster Sya is, het meisje waar hij al jaren op verliefd is. De première komt dichterbij en Rudyard verzint smoesjes om te niet te moeten zingen in de musical. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Dierendokters 24/7
programme.desc: Zes weken lang werd in de typische observerende 24/7-stijl gefilmd in de faculteit Diergeneeskunde in Merelbeke. Hier worden jaarlijks ongeveer 20.000 dieren behandeld in de 50.000 m2 aan stallen en klinieken. Bijna 2000 studenten volgen er de zware opleiding tot dierenarts. Voor de studenten van het eerste masterjaar staat er vandaag een les "klinisch onderzoek van het rund" op het programma. Ze mogen Peter de os onderzoeken. Maar Peterke is niet zomaar een rund ... Merrie Electra en haar veulen worden vanuit Noord-Frankrijk naar de faculteit gebracht. De merrie is erg vermagerd, en ook het veulen ziet er zwak uit. Oscar is een piepkleine Chihuahua. Hij weegt nauwelijks meer dan 1 kg. Nét voldoende voor de hartoperatie die hij nodig heeft. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Kinderen van Dewindt
programme.desc: Tom en Sonja kunnen hun geluk niet op wanneer ze vernemen dat Robbe wakker is. Het geluk van Tom is echter van korte duur. Door de fraudezaak werkt DFT nog niet op 1/3de van zijn capaciteit. Schepen liggen aan de ketting, PCs zijn in beslag genomen... het personeel is onzeker wat de toekomst betreft. Bob maakt zich zorgen om zijn proces. Er zijn nieuwe bewijzen opgedoken die hem kunnen schaden. Lies krijgt goed nieuws, maar de vreugde ruimt al snel plaats voor ontnuchtering. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De laatste lach
programme.desc: Donald (66) en Janne Desmet In Wommelgem kent iedereen Donald als de goedlachse friturist, die zelfs na twee gastric bypass-operaties ook nog eens het lekkerste ijs blijft draaien. Na dertig jaar hard werken in hun frituur droomden hij en zijn vrouw Lieve ervan meer tijd in Kreta door te brengen, waar ze hun hart verloren. Maar toen kreeg Donald een harde diagnose. Janne Desmet gaat mee op een van zijn laatste trips naar Kreta. Hun leven lijkt heel anders, maar gaandeweg blijken deze Antwerpse en West-Vlaamse babbelaars uit hetzelfde hout gesneden te zijn: tussen de twee sfeermakers met peperkoeken hart groeit een innige vriendschap. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Met DFT gaat het van kwaad naar erger. Een Raad van Bestuur volgt. Sumaya krijgt heel de familie tegen zich. Jaloezie drijft Ellen in de armen van Cathy. Lies voelt zich bedrogen en eenzaam. Steven is helemaal van slag door de uitspraak van de rechtbank inzake Bob. Tom is Robbe aan het verliezen. Hij denkt niet meer helder na en staat op het punt een stommiteit te begaan. Rita probeert de inspecteur te overtuigen dat Karel niets met de fraudezaak te maken had. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Dierendokters 24/7
programme.desc: Lies is studente aan de faculteit en ze heeft een van haar vijftig geitjes meegebracht voor een onderzoek en hopelijk een behandeling. Geitje Ophelia is immers hermafrodiet. Zij (of hij) is dus zowel mannelijk als vrouwelijk en dat is in de geitenwereld erg vervelend. Poes Pita is 5 jaar en wil plots niet meer eten. Bij katten betekent dat steevast dat ze zich niet goed voelen en de dierenartsen moeten dus op zoek naar de oorzaak. Kiran is een jonge hengst met een gebroken been. Hij moet geopereerd worden en Eva mag daarbij assisteren. Ze volgt een specialisatieopleiding chirurgie. Maar de operatie blijkt veel moeilijker dan verwacht. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Witse
programme.desc: Walter, een jongen met een verstandelijke beperking, ziet een moord gebeuren in het huis van Julie, de vrouw bij wie hij tewerkgesteld is in het fitnesscentrum, en voor wie hij een boontje heeft. Sam gelooft Walter direct, een uitgebluste Witse kan het allemaal zoveel niet meer schelen. Julie speelt de vermoorde onschuld, maar al gauw blijkt dat een sportleraar uit de fitness met wie ze een relatie had, verdwenen is. En de auto van haar man Robert wordt uitgebrand teruggevonden in Luxemburg. Ook hij is spoorloos ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Kijk uit
programme.desc: Verkeer draait niet alleen om regels volgen, maar ook om duidelijk communiceren met andere weggebruikers. Richtingsaanwijzers of je arm uitsteken maken je intenties kenbaar en helpen misverstanden te vermijden. Maar hoe die je dit correct en wanneer net niet? We bekijken hoe een goede communicatie op de weg bijdraagt aan een vlotte en veilige verkeersstroom. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: First dates
programme.desc: Lisa is nog niet lang uit te kast als biseksueel. Ze weet dus niet of ze met een man of een vrouw op date gaat, extra spannend. Dominique houdt van mensen en zoekt een nieuwe vriendin om samen te genieten van het leven. Ze maakt kennis met wandelfanaat Hilde. Nelle en Imar zijn nog piepjong, maar wel al klaar voor een relatie. Tom heeft nog nooit naar First Dates gekeken, hij waagt zich op onbekend terrein in zijn zoektocht naar de liefde. Hij gaat op date met de sprankelende Ady. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: F.C. De Kampioenen
programme.desc: Xavier moet drie maanden naar Afghanistan voor 'Operatie BETINA', een humanitaire opdracht. Xavier vreest de reactie van Carmen. Op aanraden van zijn collega Senne probeert hij Carmen gunstig te stemmen. Carmen laat zich de attenties van Xavier welgevallen, tot ze bij zijn legerspullen een vreemde ontdekking doet ... Boma blijft Pascale maar lastigvallen. Pascale heeft er genoeg van en zegt Boma dat hij maar een andere vrouw moet zoeken. De volgende dag verschijnt Boma met zijn nieuwe verovering Machteld, een echte klassedame! Boma ondergaat een heuse metamorfose en bij Pascale steekt een gevoel van jaloezie de kop op ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Is er een dokter in de zaal?
programme.desc: Humoristische panelquiz met Philippe Geubels over gezondheid. Samen met vier bekende gasten en een deskundige huisarts buigt Philippe zich over de zin en onzin van de medische wereld. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Amelie Albrecht: Goe genoeg
programme.desc: De afgelopen twee jaren waren een rollercoaster voor Amelie Albrecht. Haar comedy carrière schoot als een raket in de lucht, met uitsluitend uitverkochte shows en veel opdrachten voor televisie. Dàn heb je het wel gemaakt zeker. Haar vrienden waarschuwen haar: "Zie maar dat je niet arrogant wordt!". Maar dat zal haar niet overkomen: dat was ze al. Maar bekend zijn, is niet alleen rozengeur en maneschijn. Als Amelie over straat loopt, moet ze er altijd goed uitzien voor de selfies. Ze heeft een echte handtekening moeten bedenken en zelfs haar hond Duvel wordt ongewild aangeklampt. Wees maar zeker: Amelie geniet van haar succes. En die nieuwe zaalshow? Die komt er wel. En die zal wel goe genoeg zijn. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Euromillions
programme.desc: Tweewekelijkse trekking van de Euromillions jackpot waar minimaal € 17.000.000 euro in zit en maximaal 190.000.000 euro, wegens de wekelijkse overdracht. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Start to race
programme.desc: Kan iedereen leren racen? Dat is wat Jan Van Looveren wil ontdekken in Start to Race. Twaalf gewone Vlamingen, zonder race-ervaring, krijgen vier maanden om zich klaar te stomen voor een échte race. Onder begeleiding van racepiloot Sam Dejonghe beginnen ze helemaal van nul. Jan volgt hun traject van dichtbij, terwijl ze leren remmen, de juiste lijnen rijden en racen tegen anderen. Ze maken fouten, botsen op hun limieten en worden fysiek en mentaal uitgedaagd. Van Mettet tot Zolder en Spa-Francorchamps wordt de lat steeds hoger gelegd. De tijd is schaars, de druk neemt toe en de risico's worden groter. Elke racer is spe wordt geconfronteerd met zijn eigen grenzen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mr Magoo
programme.desc: Grappige animatiereeks over een behulpzaam maar slechtziend mannetje dat alles in het honderd laat lopen. Het grootste slachtoffer daarvan is Fizz, de megalomane hamster. Nederlandstalige versie (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Monster shaker
programme.desc: Justin en Gwen zijn aan het kibbelen met elkaar tijdens het tandenpoetsen en breken daarbij per ongeluk de kraan af. Opa en Gwen proberen de hoofdkraan dicht te draaien en Justin roept Thermo-Ja op om het water te stoppen. Die verandert per ongeluk het hele huis in een schaatsbaan. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mega Maffe Monsterfreaks
programme.desc: Een grappige avontuurlijke monsterreeks die kinderen stimuleert tot fantasie, tolerantie, oog voor diversiteit en creativiteit. Drie kinderen worden door hun stoere oude opa opgeleid tot monsterjagers. Er is alleen één probleem. Deze kinderen zijn enorme monsterfans. Waarom zouden ze op hun monsteridolen willen jagen? Nederlandstalige versie (orig.: 'Monster Loving Maniacs') (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Lou
programme.desc: Animatiereeks over het dagelijkse leven van het 12-jarige meisje Lou en haar vrienden die op de drempel van de adolescentie staan. Gebaseerd op de gelijknamige stripreeks van Julien Neel. Nederlandstalige versie (orig.: 'Lou!') (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Dodo
programme.desc: Animatiereeks over de belevenissen van de 11-jarige Joe Connolly die in het eerste jaar van de middelbare school zit. Nederlandstalige versie (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Zotte dieren
programme.desc: Liveactionreeks waarin Gary, de vloggende hond de grappigste (huis)dierenclips laat zien. Nederlandstalige versie (orig.: 'Silly Pets') (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De week van Karrewiet met VGT
De regels van Floor
programme.desc: Nederlandse fictiereeks over de eigenzinnige Floor en haar gedachtes. Want In Floors wereld bedenken kinderen, net als volwassenen, hun eigen regels en dat leidt tot bijzondere inzichten. Gebaseerd op de gelijknamige boekenreeks van Marjon Hoffman. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Zee in zicht
programme.desc: Vandaag gaat het op zee over gezondheid en daarom heeft Karen niet één maar twéé collega's meegebracht om Nona iets bij te leren. Wat een luxe! Elias en Julia weten als geen ander welk effect de zee kan hebben op onze gezondheid. En dat effect is veel groter dan je misschien denkt... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: In haar verkiezingsvideo is Soekie eerlijk dat er moet bespaard worden door de leerlingenraad. Pedro daarentegen belooft in zijn video dat alles beter wordt. Hij blijft bewust vaag om de leerlingen te misleiden. De Brollers trappen erin en zullen allemaal op Pedro stemmen. Soekie verliest al haar moed omdat haar eerlijkheid niet gewaardeerd wordt en beslist om onmiddellijk te stoppen als voorzitter. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De Hoppers
programme.desc: Het is weer zover. De Hoppers vieren hun jaarlijkse Wally Wasbeerdag. Daria zit ondertussen in een lastige positie. Omdat ze de beste punten wil halen voor een groepswerk van wiskunde, heeft ze Olivia gevraagd in plaats van Esra. Daria wil niet dat Esra dit te weten komt. Dat wordt moeilijk wanneer Esra plots opdaagt om mee Wally Wasbeerdag te vieren. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: United
programme.sub-title: *** Titel der Episode noch nicht bekannt ***
programme.desc: Loubna heeft er genoeg van dat haar papa steeds staat te roepen langs de zijlijn. Ze neemt daardoor een drastische beslissing. Selma ontdekt dat Hannes en Xander in het geheim samen trainen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Spellbound
programme.desc: Een 15-jarig meisje verhuist van een klein stadje in de VS naar Parijs om ballet te studeren, maar haar dansdroom neemt een bovennatuurlijke wending wanneer ze een boek met familiespreuken ontdekt en per ongeluk magische mysteries in haar leven loslaat. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Erediensten
programme.desc: De protestantse eredienst komt vanuit de Protestantse Kerk van Turnhout. De dienst wordt voorgegaan door predikant Marcel Pool. Het thema van de viering is 'Gebruik je talenten'. Dienstdoend ambtsdrager is Marie-Josée Zagers. Organist is Peter Van Hoof. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Radio 1 Boekenfeest
programme.desc: Compilatie van het Radio 1 Boekenfeest vanop Boektopia in Kortrijk (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Kinderen van Dewindt
programme.desc: Ellen voelt zich schuldig en neemt afstand van Cathy. Sonja wil Robbe mee naar Athene nemen, maar Robbe wil ook bij z'n papa blijven... Sumaya werkt niet langer voor DFT. Vanaf heden is Steven CEO van het familiebedrijf. De blaam op DFT is verleden tijd, maar de smet op Karels naam blijft. Rita geeft zich niet zomaar gewonnen en blijft volharden in de onschuld van Karel. Bob en Fons krijgen onenigheid. Fons verliest zijn zelfbeheersing en gaat Bob te lijf... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Dierendokters 24/7
programme.desc: Het veulen van merrie Electra heeft na de geboorte niet genoeg goede biestmelk gekregen. Ze is daardoor heel vatbaar voor infecties. De dierenartsen vrezen dat het veulen inderdaad al een infectie van de gewrichten heeft opgelopen. Dokus is een speurhond. Hij wordt wel eens ingezet om vermiste personen terug te vinden. Maar het gaat niet goed met Dokus en op de faculteit moeten de dierenartsen uitzoeken wat er precies aan de hand is. Goldie is een kip. Haar baasjes zijn erg aan haar gehecht. Maar Goldie heeft iets aan haar snavel dat doet denken aan pokken ... een erg besmettelijk virus. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De playlist
programme.desc: Muziekprogramma waarin een artiest van bij ons zijn of haar playlist van favoriete nummers voorstelt uit het rijke VRT-archief, doorspekt met eigen anekdotes en persoonlijke herinneringen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Witse
programme.desc: Een pyromaan teistert Halle. De schade is aanzienlijk, maar er vallen geen doden. Tot op een nacht een schrootschip uitbrandt en de eigenaar dood teruggevonden wordt in de resten. Blijkt dat de man een tiran was die zijn gezin de duvel aandeed. De oudste zoon is een aardje naar zijn vaartje, de jongste is een eerder introverte kerel die de stress moeilijk aankan. Het slachtoffer is niet in de vlammen omgekomen, maar werd eerst de schedel ingeslagen... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Heimatleuchten
programme.desc: E67 — Unsere Nationalparks - Gewaltiges GesäuseAuf den Spuren alter und längst vergessener Traditionen und Geschichten kommt man um das Gesäuse in der Steiermark nicht herum. So wird von einem Bäcker ein 300 Jahre altes Rezept aus der Stiftsbibliothek Admont wiederbelebt.

programme.desc: Die Reise beginnt an der Zugspitze und führt durch das Grenzgebiet zwischen Bayern und Tirol. Ein Rundflug über die Bergwelt und die Drei-Zinken-Spitze bildet den letzten Höhepunkt, bevor die Reise schließlich am Achensee endet.

programme.title: Heimatleuchten
programme.desc: E70 — Die Nockberge - Inmitten grüner GigantenDas unverwechselbare, grasige Erscheinungsbild der Nockberge wurde nicht nur von der Natur über Millionen von Jahren gestaltet, sondern auch entschieden von den Bewohnern der Gebirgsregion in Kärnten, der Steiermark und Salzburg geprägt. Seit über 700 Jahren gibt es hier verbriefte Weiderechte. Heute grasen weit mehr als 1000 Rinder auf den verschiedenen Almen. Bis zu acht Stunden kann der Almauftrieb im Frühsommer dauern.

programme.title: Heimatleuchten

So wird von einem Bäcker ein 300 Jahre altes Rezept aus der Stiftsbibliothek Admont wiederbelebt.

programme.title: Heimatleuchten
programme.desc: E70 — Die Nockberge - Inmitten grüner GigantenDas unverwechselbare, grasige Erscheinungsbild der Nockberge wurde nicht nur von der Natur über Millionen von Jahren gestaltet, sondern auch entschieden von den Bewohnern der Gebirgsregion in Kärnten, der Steiermark und Salzburg geprägt. Seit über 700 Jahren gibt es hier verbriefte Weiderechte. Heute grasen weit mehr als 1000 Rinder auf den verschiedenen Almen. Bis zu acht Stunden kann der Almauftrieb im Frühsommer dauern.

programme.title: Faszination Heimat
programme.desc: S2 E6 — Die Honigmacher - Kein Leben ohne die BieneSie ist ein faszinierendes Tier und für das Überleben der Menschen entscheidender, als die meisten denken: Die Biene produziert nicht nur Honig, sie bestäubt auch fast 80 Prozent der Nutzpflanzen, die für eine gesunde Ernährung unverzichtbar sind. Stefan Mandl hat sein Leben diesen kleinen, erstaunlichen Insekten verschrieben. Der studierte Bienenforscher und Imker hat seinen ersten Bienenstock vor 15 Jahren übernommen.

programme.title: Joyce Meyer - Das Leben genießen
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Wären Sie gerne mit sich selbst befreundet? In dieser Sendung beschäftigt sich Joyce Meyer mit dem Thema Beziehungen und geht der Frage nach, wie wir die Herzen anderer erobern können. Ein Tipp schon einmal vorweg: Öfter mal die Sprache des Lächelns sprechen.

programme.title: Antworten mit Bayless Conley
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Manchmal führen tiefe Verletzungen durch andere oder eigene Schuldgefühle zu einer schweren Belastung. Anhand der Geschichte von Jona zeigt Bayless Conley, dass Gottes Barmherzigkeit weiter reicht, als es oft denkbar scheint - sowohl für die Mitmenschen als auch für das eigene Leben. Bayless Conley erklärt, warum Unversöhnlichkeit in eine innere Gefangenschaft führt und wie Gottes Gnade einen Weg in die Freiheit eröffnet, weil jeder eine zweite Chance verdient.

programme.title: Kraftvoll leben
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Etliche Menschen merken mit Blick auf ihr Leben, dass ihnen die Zeit ausgeht. Viele Dinge fressen unsere Zeit auf und zeigen wenig Wert und Wirkung. In dieser Botschaft geht es darum, einen Unterschied zu machen und Spuren zu hinterlassen. Das Geheimnis eines produktiven Lebens liegt in den richtigen Prioritäten begründet, ist Pastor Andreas Herrmann überzeugt.

programme.title: Bibel TV Emmaus
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Hartmut Jaeger spricht über den Bibeltext Matthäus 14,22-24.

programme.title: Erlebt TV
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Wer Anthony und Manfred in jungen Jahren kannte, hätte sie im Erwachsenenalter eher im Gefängnis als auf der Kanzel vermutet - denn lange Zeit drehte sich ihr Leben nicht um den christlichen Glauben, sondern um Sucht und Drogen. Beide Männer erzählen, wie es dazu kam, dass sie heute als Pastor arbeiten. (Moderation: Sabine Bhandari / Andreas Waldmann)

programme.title: Bibel TV Das Gespräch
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Niels Petersen wollte das große Geld machen und das durch Drogenhandel in Kolumbien. Manche seiner Erlebnisse hören sich an wie Filmdrehbücher: Er überlebte einen Mordversuch, wurde beim Schmuggel gefasst und saß in einem kolumbianischen Gefängnis. Heute sieht Niels Petersens Leben ganz anders aus. Er predigt und rappt über seinen christlichen Glauben. Wie es zu dieser Lebenswende kam, berichtet er im Gespräch mit Moderator Daniel Deman.

programme.title: Bibel TV Sing Mit!
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Singen erfreut, erfüllt und macht einfach Spaß. Choräle, Kirchen- und Glaubenslieder moderner Interpreten laden ein zum Mitsingen. Die Liedtexte sind eingeblendet.

programme.title: Hautnah - Gott mitten im Leben
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Prof. Dr. Angelika Bier war an der Berliner Charité als Oberärztin an der Klinik für Mund-, Kiefer- und Gesichtschirurgie tätig. Im Dezember 2005 gründete sie mit ihrem Ehemann die Stiftung Jona, die sich um sozial benachteiligte Kinder und Jugendliche kümmert. Auf der Grundlage christlichen Glaubens erfahren Kinder und Jugendliche dort Geborgenheit, Unterstützung und Perspektive für ihre Zukunft.

programme.title: Gottes Häuser
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Mit 161,53 Metern ist das Ulmer Münster nicht nur um einiges höher als der Kölner Dom, es reichte bis zum Jahr 2025 auch aus, um höchster Kirchturm der Welt zu sein. Die Kirche am Münsterplatz ist aber auch Bürgerkirche. Denn es waren vor allem die Bürger, die dafür gesorgt haben, dass die im gotischen Baustil errichtete Kirche nach 513 Jahren Bauzeit fertiggestellt werden konnte. Münsterpfarrerin Tabea Frey (2002-2016) zeigt, warum das Ulmer Münster nicht nur eine besondere Kirche in der Stadt, sondern auch für die Stadt ist.

programme.title: Superbuch
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Der indische Nachbarsjunge stellt Chris vor eine große sprachliche Herausforderung. Auch Gizmo kann nicht übersetzen, denn beim Herunterladen einiger Updates ist sein Übersetzungsprogramm durcheinandergeraten. Da schickt das Superbuch Joy, Chris und Gizmo an zwei Orte in der biblischen Geschichte, an denen Sprache ebenso eine große Rolle spielt. Können die drei durch diesen Ausflug auch etwas für ihr Leben lernen?

programme.title: Gesichter der Verfolgung
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Jung, Witwe und alleinerziehend, alles denkbar schlechte Karten für Azita. Bei Jesus findet sie Freude und darüber redet sie. Wird ihr auch der Sohn weggenommen?

programme.title: Kraftvoll leben
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND In der heutigen Zeit, wo wir mit so vielen Ablenkungsmöglichkeiten, Entscheidungen und Informationen zu tun haben, ist es wichtig, sich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren, um für die Zukunft gestärkt zu werden. Gott möchte mit uns reden, um uns neue Kraft in turbulenten Zeiten zu schenken und uns unsere Bestimmung zu zeigen. Aber hören wir ihn auch?

programme.title: Freude am Leben
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Das Kreuz ist mehr als ein Symbol - es ist der Ort der Veränderung. Jesus trug am Kreuz Schuld, Angst, Krankheit und Hoffnungslosigkeit, um Menschen den Weg in eine neue Freiheit zu ebnen. Diese Predigt zeigt auf, warum das Kreuz ein Seitenwechsel ist. Sie verdeutlicht, wie Vergebung das Leben verändert, warum Jesu Kraft auch in der heutigen Zeit erlebbar bleibt und wie Sorgen, Nöte sowie innere Belastungen abgelegt werden können. Jesus kennt die menschlichen Ängste, Schmerzen und Kämpfe - und seine Auferstehungskraft erweist sich als stärker als jede Angst und Begrenzung.

programme.title: Hautnah - Gott mitten im Leben
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Christen sollten sich nicht in ihre Häuser zurückziehen, sondern ihren Glauben bezeugen. Davon ist der ehemalige Rocker aus der Clique der "Warriors" und Autor des Buches "Vom Rocker zum Retter" überzeugt. Martin Schrott ist heute froh, dass ihn andere gefragt haben, ob er Jesus kennenlernen will, obwohl er davon gar nichts wissen wollte.

programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Niels Petersen wollte das große Geld machen und das durch Drogenhandel in Kolumbien. Manche seiner Erlebnisse hören sich an wie Filmdrehbücher: Er überlebte einen Mordversuch, wurde beim Schmuggel gefasst und saß in einem kolumbianischen Gefängnis. Heute sieht Niels Petersens Leben ganz anders aus. Er predigt und rappt über seinen christlichen Glauben. Wie es zu dieser Lebenswende kam, berichtet er im Gespräch mit Moderator Daniel Deman.

Sie berichten, wie sie durch ihre Kunst eine tiefere Verbindung zu Gott erfahren und mit ihren Werken Menschen auf vielfältige Weise berühren und inspirieren. (Moderation: Sabine Bhandari / Andreas Waldmann)

programme.title: Alpha & Omega
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Studentin Jasmin Fuchs sitzt in ihrer WG-Küche, als sie auf einmal starke Kopfschmerzen auf der rechten Seite verspürt. Ihr fällt das Sprechen schwer, sie kann ihre linke Körperhälfte nicht mehr bewegen und rutscht vom Sofa. Im Krankenhaus folgt die Schock-Diagnose: Schlaganfall! Jasmin Fuchs ist zu diesem Zeitpunkt erst 18 Jahre alt. Wie sie diesen Abend erlebt hat, wie sie sich seitdem zurück ins Leben kämpft und was ihr Halt gibt, darüber spricht sie mit Moderatorin Juliane Eberwein.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Unterwegs ...
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Er war ein einfacher Zimmermann. Doch kaum ein Mensch hat das Weltgeschehen so beeinflusst wie er: Jesus von Nazaret. In dieser Staffel von Drive Thru History begibt sich Dave Stotts auf die Spuren dieses außergewöhnlichen Mannes. Wie war die politische Lage in Israel? Wie war die Situation der Juden? Wie präsent war die Erwartung des Messias im täglichen Leben? Auf der Suche nach Antworten braust Dave in einem alten Jeep kreuz und quer durchs Heilige Land und durchdringt die Evangelien, wie sie die Bibel überliefert.

programme.title: Kirche neu erleben - mit Tobias Teichen
programme.desc: BIBELTV: CHRISTLICH MEISTGESEHEN LEBENSVERÄNDERND Das Alte Testament ist der spannende Boden, in dem der christliche Glaube seine Wurzeln hat. Hier beginnt die leidenschaftliche Liebe Gottes und sein Plan für uns Menschen. Hier werden die Grundlagen für ein gutes, fruchtbares Miteinander gelegt. Tobias Teichen schaut Ursachen und Grundlagen christlichen Glaubens an und stellt die Frage: Was ist der neue Bund?

programme.title: So lebt sich's gut
